entries.fact: Final: Cleveland 93, Golden State 89. Cleveland became the first team to win the Finals from 3-1 down.
entries.source: Basketball-Reference box score, 2016 NBA Finals Game 7

entries.fact: Kyrie Irving: 26 points; the go-ahead 25-foot three over Curry with 53 seconds left, score tied 89-89.
entries.source: NBA.com: Top Finals moments, Irving's three (Appendix C)

entries.fact: LeBron James: triple-double; the chase-down block on Andre Iguodala with about 1:50 left.
Stephen Curry: 17 points, 6 of 19 from the field, 4 of 14 from three.
entries.source: Land of Basketball: Game 7 box score (Appendix C)

entries.fact: Klay Thompson: 14 points, 2 of 10 from three.
